snippet.title: Relic Guardian - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Relic Guardian is a dynamic pixel-art tower defense game where you control a summoned hero who can move and reposition towers in real time to adapt to ever-changing battlefields. Relic Guardian will be available on PC in Q3 2025.
